issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

createAssetIdFromLineage.description:
Flag indicating if {@link ReliabilityAsset} id should be generated from lineage for {@link ReliabilityExcelParser#preprocessExcelTemplateFile}.
Set to true if id should be generated from lineage, set to false to preserve the original id from customer data.

typesToClearOnExcelReuploads.description:
Asset Hierarchy-related types to clear on the re-upload of an Asset Hierarchy Excel file with the same name.
Entities of these types populated by a previous upload of an Excel file with the same name will be removed.
Relation types will already be automatically removed if references are no longer valid.

Types in this list:
  * must mix in {@link AssetOnboardingMeta}
  * should not have entities which may be referenced by more than one Excel file, if uploading multiple Excel files containing different pieces of data

relationTypesToClearBadTemplateData.description:
Types in the below list that have hierarchial relationship, which needs to be cleared when {@link AssetOnboardingSourceFile#clearUploadedEntities}
is called.

nonRelationTypesToClearBadTemplateData.description:
Types in the below list are non-relational types, which needs to be cleared when {@link AssetOnboardingSourceFile#clearUploadedEntities}
is called.

returnAssetsClearedOnExcelReuploads.description:
Determines whether {@link ReliabilityExcelParser#preprocessExcelTemplateFile} returns assets cleared during the Excel re-upload
Asset type is based on ReliabilityAssetOnboardingConfig#assetTypeName

Note:
 * setting this to true will result in performance degradation.
 * however, it will provide clarity of what assets were cleared on a bad asset uploads.

createPpmsFromSensors.description:
Flag indicating if {@link PointPhysicalMeasurementSeries} instances should be created based on the Sensor column of {@link AssetClass}.
Set to true if {@link PointPhysicalMeasurementSeries} should be created for each {@link Sensor} in the {@link AssetClass}.
Set to false if {@link PointPhysicalMeasurementSeries} will be ingested through the appropriate canonical.

defaultPpmsGrain.description: If {@link createPpmsFromSensors} is set to true, this field is used to set the default grain for {@link PointPhysicalMeasurementSeries}.

assetTypeName.description: The type name that represents the Asset entity.

additionalTypeNames.description: Additional custom type names that need to be ingested.

refreshNormalization.description:
Flag to indicate if at the end of the Asset Hierarchy Load, we should refresh the
{@link PointPhysicalMeasurementSeries} for the newly created {@link Sensor} entities.

refreshFacilityACLs.description: Flag to indicate if at the end of the Asset Hierarchy Load, we should refresh the {@link Facility} ACLs.

assetClassLimit.description: The Limit for fetching Asset Classes. The default value is set to 2000 but can be increased.
